_help: Quiz for Ways to Earn Small. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: What is an airdrop?
options: Free tokens a project gives to early users
questions.answer: Free tokens a project gives to early users
questions.explain: Projects reward early, genuine users. It is never guaranteed.

questions.question: A site asks you to pay a small fee to claim your airdrop. What is it?
options: A good deal if the fee is low
questions.explain: Real airdrops never ask you to pay to claim.

questions.question: Which is a real way to earn with writing in web3?
options: Writing docs, guides or research for projects
Paying to join a writing club
questions.answer: Writing docs, guides or research for projects
questions.explain: Clear writing is in demand. Publish samples so people can see your work.

questions.question: What helps most when applying for a first web3 internship?
options: Links to public work you have already done
A fee paid to a recruiter
questions.answer: Links to public work you have already done
questions.explain: A proof of work list beats any CV line.

questions.question: Why use a separate wallet when testing new apps or claiming rewards?
options: So a bad app cannot touch your main savings
questions.answer: So a bad app cannot touch your main savings
questions.explain: Keep experiments away from the money you care about.

questions.question: A 'job' asks for an activation fee before you start. What should you do?
options: Walk away, real jobs never charge you
questions.answer: Walk away, real jobs never charge you
questions.explain: Paying to earn is the classic job scam.
